Whenever Big Troubler picks up a gold pick-up from the ground, his starting weapon is triggered, regardless of its current cooldown. This effect can trigger multiple time depending on the amount of gold received from the pick-up, with 1 gold equaling 1 activation and each activation having a delay of 1 frame.
When Big Troubler collects gold during a run, he uses it as a shield/secondary

bar. Any damage taken will instead be subtracted from the player's current gold count for that run. Once the player's gold count is reduced to 0, Big Troubler will begin receiving damage to his health bar again. Big Troubler has reduced Invulnerability Time when he takes damage while carrying gold.
Big Troubler has a 4 times higher chance of drafting FOIL
Survarots, and a 2 times chance of drafting a Survarot with an Edition in general.
Big Troubler destroys light sources automatically when coming into contact with them.

Big Troubler is a reference to David Lo Pan, the main antagonist of the 1986 film
The spell for unlocking Big Troubler is also a reference to the film, as David Lo Pan seeks to marry a woman with green eyes and sacrifice her to the god Ching Dai in order to gain immortality.

The appearance of Big Troubler (or David Lo Pan) is a reference to the Loong Kings (Dragon Kings) in Chinese myths. The several Loong Kings, one in each sea, live in underwater palaces on the seabeds, and are in charge of creating rainfall and floods. The appearance of the green loong of
, which is the evolution of Big Troubler's starting weapon
, is also an evidence.
